content: आनत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Respectfully saluted or bowed to. .²2 (Actively used) Bent down, bending, stooping, inclined; कुसुमानताः (तरवः) <ls>Ki. 5. 25</ls>; <ls>Rs. 6. 3</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>); पादानतः <ls>Ku. 3. 8</ls>; so प्रश्रय˚, फलभार˚. .²3 Making a low bow, saluting respectfully; (प्रतिजग्राह) आदेशं देशकालज्ञः शिष्यः शासितुरानतः <ls>R. 1. 92</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 69</ls>. .²4 Humble, obedient, submissive, pacified, conciliated.
